typography.setup_instructions: Add Google Fonts imports for Chakra Petch and Rajdhani in index.css. Use Tailwind configuration to extend font families.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento 'Tetris' Grid for Homepage. Asymmetric blocks with 1px borders and heavy glassmorphism.
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. gap-8 for grids.
layout_and_spacing.container_borders: All containers must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-[#b026ff] text-[#b026ff] hover:bg-[#b026ff] hover:text-white hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(176,38,255,0.6)] px-8 py-3 uppercase tracking-widest font-bold transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white hover:border-[#00f3ff] hover:text-[#00f3ff] hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,243,255,0.4)] px-8 py-3 uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-300

components.cards: bg-[#0a0a0f]/40 border border-white/5 hover:border-[#b026ff]/50 hover:bg-[#12121a]/60 transition-colors duration-300

icons.instructions: Use Lucide React. Keep icons sharp and thin to match the futuristic technical aesthetic.

effects.grain_overlay: Apply a subtle noise texture (SVG or CSS) over the deep black background to remove the 'digital flat' look.
effects.hover_glow: Do not use solid neon backgrounds for hover. Use 1px neon borders combined with drop-shadows to simulate light bleed.
effects.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling to add a premium feel to the high-contrast aesthetic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme #050505 base background. Avoid standard white/light grey SaaS elements.
Use Chakra Petch for all headings to establish the mecha/cyberpunk vibe.
Implement a 'Bento Box' grid on the homepage showcasing the different categories using the provided generated images.
For product cards, keep corners sharp (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to match the techwear/cyberpunk look.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive and key informational elements for robust testing.
Ensure the header uses heavy backdrop-blur (glassmorphism) over the hero image.
For the Hero image overlay, use bg-black/60 to ensure the tagline 'POWER YOUR ANIME WORLD' in neon cyan/purple pops.
Do NOT use raw input elements, fallback to Shadcn/UI for checkout/cart, fully customized to match neon aesthetics.
